description: Today, the Alaska First Coordinated Campaign announced that more than 10,000 Alaskans have signed up to help elect Mary Peltola to the U.S. Senate – an unprecedented show of grassroots force that signals Alaskans are fired up and ready for change.

title: Alaska First Coordinated Campaign Announces More than 10,000 Alaskan Volunteer Signups to Help Elect Mary Peltola - Mary Peltola
